info.title: Haven local API
info.description: Development-only single workspace. EUR. No authentication yet; bind loopback only.

parameters.name: timezone
parameters.description: Device IANA timezone for the upcoming 30-day window; defaults to UTC.

parameters.name: entries
parameters.description: preview returns at most 200 recent entries for attachment context; all totals still include every entry. Use /entries for the paginated activity feed.
